## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows existing module boundaries.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior.
- [ ] User-facing documentation and both locales are updated when needed.
- [ ] No credentials, cookies, signed URLs, private papers, local paths, or generated files are included.
- [ ] Privacy, compatibility, and third-party protocol effects are described below.
